page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top with the page number 87 at the top right. Running text in one column, with a woodcut initial opening the sermon. Sermon heading and Scripture reference above the italic passage. No marginal notes. Signature "F 4" at the foot right.

main_text.p: ta[?]onem paratum damnant. Ut autem ser-uus ille Rebeccæ inaures aureas, & armillas pondo siclorum decem dedit: sic Apostoli, dispensatores donorum Dei, fidem, quæ ex auditu verbi Dei est, & charita-tem, quæ consistit in seruandis decem præceptis Dei, annunciant. Hanc fidem, quæ fit per charita-tem efficax, adaugeat nobis Dominus noster Iesus Christus, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO X.
Genes. 24.

p.i: ABEBAT autem Rebecca fratrem nomine Laban: & is cucurrit ad virum foras, nepe ad fontem. Et factum est, cum vidisset inaurem, & armillas in manibus sororis suæ, & cum audisset verba Rebeccæ sororis suæ dicentis: Sic locutus est ad me vir ille: venit ad virum: & ecce is stabat apud fontem iuxta gamelos. Et dixit: Veni benedicte Domini, cur stas foris? & ego quidem præparaui domum & locum pro gamelis. Intrauit itaque vir ille domum, & soluit gamelos. & dedit (Laban) paleam & pabulum gamelis, atque aquam, ut lauarent pedes suos, & pedes virorum qui cum illo erant. Apposuit quoque corāeo ut comederet: at ille ait: non

page.notes: Woodcut initial "A" at the start of the Genesis paragraph, joined to "BEBAT". The first word of the page "ta[?]onem" is unclear: a small raised mark stands in the place of a letter, and the line-end hyphen is not clear. The word "ser-uus" is printed "fer-uus"; the long s is read as a plain s, so the reading is "ser-" with a hyphen at the line end. "gamelos" and "gamelis" are kept as printed. "corāeo" has a macron over the a as printed. The Scripture reference "Genes. 24." is a level 3 heading. The line "Laban" in the italic text is printed "Laba" with a tilde, which is kept as "Laban" in the italic text; this is a doubtful reading.
